behavioral_effects: make dev-codecov succeeds from any shell once the CODECOV_* block is in a root .env, independent of when the shell or its parent application was started
compatibility_impact: None for prod (prod-codecov unchanged, still backend/.env). dev-codecov gains a second credential source; shell exports still work and still take precedence. No compose, image, port, or contract change.
limitations: The root .env is Compose's global interpolation source, so any other interpolated variable placed there (POSTGRES_PASSWORD, MINIO_ROOT_USER, DOMAIN) applies to the whole dev stack; the docs say to copy only the CODECOV_* block, but nothing enforces that

The proof of the full boot from .env alone stopped at the pre-existing-volume password mismatch, which is expected behaviour rather than a defect; the guard-and-interpolation half is proven, the fresh-volume boot from .env alone was proven in the original session with equivalent values
reason: make dev-codecov guards its credentials by inspecting the shell environment only, while Docker Compose interpolates the same variables from a root .env automatically; an operator who puts the CODECOV_* values in .env or the Windows registry still hits the placeholder guard from any shell that predates the change, so the guard rejects a configuration Compose would happily use � pointing the dev-codecov guard at .env makes the file Compose reads and the file the guard reads the same file
rollback: git revert. Nothing outside the repository is affected; an operator's root .env is theirs and is not created or removed by this change.
security_impact: Reduces secret sprawl: dev credentials can live in a single gitignored root .env instead of shell exports or Windows user-scope environment variables. The root .env matches the existing top-level .gitignore rule (verified with git check-ignore); no secret values are recorded or committed. Guard precedence (process env, then file) equals Compose's own precedence, so the guard can neither pass on a value Compose would ignore nor reject one Compose would use.
summary: Let dev-codecov read credentials from the root .env that Compose already interpolates
